The successful candidate will utilize their skills in programming, and software coding techniques to create, revise, and enhance business systems application programs.

Responsibilities

• Develop system logic, flowcharts, and comprehensive documentation, including user manuals and technical guides.

• Perform other related technical duties as assigned by the supervisor to support system stability and improvements.

Qualifications

• Strong knowledge of programming languages, including ASP.Net, C#, Python, and others.
• Experience with database servers, SQL language, and handling large datasets.
• Experience in software engineering and algorithm structures.
• Ability to read, analyze, & debug programming codes in the above-mentioned languages, including ML libraries.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly accomplished Principal Software Engineer to serve as the foremost technical authority within our Product Engineering & Technology (PET) division. This is a hands-on leadership position for an exceptional software architect and engineering practitioner who will define the technical direction of our flagship cybersecurity products while driving the adoption of sovereign cryptography and Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) principles across our technology ecosystem.

The successful candidate will architect and deliver high-assurance software solutions that operate seamlessly across both enterprise environments and highly sensitive sovereign, air-gapped infrastructures. This individual will establish engineering standards, govern secure software development practices, and provide strategic technical leadership across the organization.

Sovereign Architecture & Backend Engineering
• Define and lead the architecture, development, and deployment of highly resilient backend services using Python and FastAPI.
• Establish and enforce engineering standards, coding practices, and architectural principles across the software development organization.
• Design scalable microservices architectures capable of operating in both connected and disconnected sovereign environments.
• Embed advanced cryptographic controls into applications, including:
• Sovereign cryptographic frameworks
• Secure key management implementations
• Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) readiness
• Secure data protection mechanisms for data in transit and at rest
• Ensure compliance with NCA Essential Cybersecurity Controls (ECC) and other applicable security frameworks.

Frontend Engineering & Systems Integration
• Lead the design and development of modern, highly responsive frontend platforms using Vue.js, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
• Architect seamless integration between application platforms and specialized cybersecurity hardware appliances deployed within Operational Technology (OT) environments.
• Ensure reliable real-time communication, synchronization, and data integrity across distributed systems.
• Drive frontend performance optimization, scalability, and maintainability across the CyProducts ecosystem.

Technical Leadership & Engineering Excellence
• Act as the highest technical escalation point for complex software engineering challenges.
• Mentor senior engineers and technical leads, fostering a culture of engineering excellence and innovation.
• Define and mandate best practices for:
• Software architecture
• Code quality
• System reliability
• Security engineering
• Performance optimization
• Review critical architectural decisions and provide authoritative technical direction.

Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC)
• Champion and enforce Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) practices across all engineering teams.
• Establish security-first engineering processes from project inception through deployment and maintenance.
• Design and implement secure CI/CD pipelines leveraging GitLab CI/CD.
• Drive automated security validation including:
• Static Application Security Testing (SAST)
• Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST)
• Dependency and container security scanning
• Infrastructure security validation
• Ensure software releases meet stringent security and quality standards before deployment.

Strategic Architecture & Innovation
• Define the long-term technical roadmap for software platforms and engineering practices.
• Lead initiatives to reduce technical debt while maintaining delivery velocity.
• Evaluate and introduce emerging technologies, frameworks, and cryptographic approaches.
• Support the organization's strategic vision for sovereign cybersecurity solutions and secure digital transformation.

Required Qualifications

Education
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
• Master's degree preferred.

Experience
• Minimum 10 years of professional software engineering experience.
• Significant experience operating at Principal Engineer, Lead Architect, or equivalent senior technical leadership level.
• Proven track record designing and delivering complex distributed systems within high-security or mission-critical environments.
• Extensive hands-on coding experience with continued involvement in architecture and software development.

Preferred Certifications
• Certified Secure Software Lifecycle Professional (CSSLP)
• Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS)
• Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect
• CISSP
• GIAC Secure Software Programmer (GSSP)
• TOGAF (Architecture)

Company Description

MUAF – Military Uniforms & Accessories Factory is a prominent manufacturer based in Al-Kharj , specializing in the production of high-quality uniforms, military gear, and civilian apparel. Our commitment to quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction has made us a trusted partner to a range of sectors, including defense, law enforcement, and private enterprises. We pride ourselves on delivering durable, comfortable, and reliable solutions to our clients.

Job Purpose

Responsible for the development, maintenance, support, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of software applications and industrial machine systems within the manufacturing environment.

The role combines Software Engineering and Industrial Software Engineering, with responsibility for software applications, databases, system integration, Industrial PCs, machine-related software, HMI/SCADA systems, and IT/OT connectivity.

The position works closely with IT, Production, Maintenance, Engineering, and machine vendors to ensure the reliability, availability, security, and effective integration of software and industrial systems supporting manufacturing operations.

Key Accountabilities

1. Software Engineering & Application Support
• Develop, maintain, enhance, and support software applications according to business and operational requirements.
• Analyze business and technical requirements and translate them into effective software solutions.
• Develop and maintain applications, utilities, and tools required to support manufacturing operations.
• Perform software testing, debugging, troubleshooting, and issue resolution.
• Develop and maintain databases and SQL queries required by applications and operational systems.
• Develop and maintain APIs and system interfaces where required.
• Manage software versions, configurations, updates, and application dependencies.
• Maintain appropriate technical documentation, source code, configurations, and system specifications.
• Identify opportunities to improve application performance, reliability, usability, and maintainability.

2. Industrial Software & Machine Systems
• Support and maintain software applications used for the operation, monitoring, and control of industrial machines and production equipment.
• Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot software running on Industrial PCs and machine operator workstations.
• Support machine-related applications, including HMI, SCADA, and other industrial software platforms.
• Troubleshoot software and communication issues between industrial machines, controllers, Industrial PCs, and related systems.
• Maintain machine software configurations, parameters, licenses, backups, and critical system files.
• Support machine software installation, commissioning, upgrades, migrations, and replacements.
• Maintain software compatibility between machine applications, operating systems, hardware, and related industrial components.
• Coordinate with machine manufacturers and software vendors to resolve complex technical issues.

3. IT/OT Integration
• Support the integration between Information Technology (IT) and Operational Technology (OT) environments.
• Support the exchange of data between machines, production systems, databases, and enterprise applications.
• Develop or support solutions for automated collection, processing, and reporting of machine and production data.
• Support integration with systems such as SAP, MES, databases, BI/reporting platforms, and other enterprise applications where applicable.
• Support industrial communication technologies and protocols such as OPC/OPC UA where applicable.
• Work with Network and Infrastructure teams to ensure reliable connectivity between industrial systems and approved IT systems.

4. Manufacturing & Production Support
• Provide technical software support to Production, Maintenance, Engineering, and other manufacturing teams.
• Respond to software-related incidents that may affect machine availability or production continuity.
• Analyze recurring issues and implement corrective and preventive solutions.
• Participate in machine installation, commissioning, testing, and acceptance activities from the software and IT/OT perspective.
• Support production during critical software incidents and planned maintenance activities.
• Ensure appropriate change management procedures are followed before implementing changes to production systems.

5. Backup, Recovery & Business Continuity
• Maintain reliable backups of machine software, configurations, databases, applications, and critical system files.
• Periodically verify the integrity and recoverability of backups.
• Maintain recovery procedures for critical machine-related software and systems.
• Support disaster recovery and business continuity activities for critical industrial applications.

6. Cybersecurity & Compliance
• Apply IT and OT cybersecurity requirements to machine-related software and Industrial PCs.
• Coordinate with the Cybersecurity team to identify and mitigate cybersecurity risks affecting industrial systems.
• Ensure appropriate controls are applied to software installation, access, updates, remote access, and system changes.
• Support vulnerability remediation and security patching in accordance with approved procedures and production requirements.
• Ensure compliance with company IT policies, cybersecurity standards, and change management procedures.

7. Vendor & Stakeholder Management
• Coordinate with machine manufacturers, software vendors, system integrators, and external technical support providers.
• Define and communicate technical requirements to vendors.
• Follow up on technical issues, software updates, patches, licenses, and support agreements.
• Participate in technical evaluations and acceptance testing of new machine software and systems.
• Maintain appropriate technical documentation and vendor information.

Technical Skills & Competencies

Software Engineering
• Programming and software development.
• Application development and maintenance.
• SQL and database management.
• API development and system integration.
• Software testing and debugging.
• Version control systems such as Git.
• Windows-based application environments.

Industrial Systems
• Industrial PC configuration and support.
• HMI and SCADA systems.
• Basic understanding of PLCs and industrial automation.
• Machine control and monitoring software.
• Industrial communication and networking.
• OPC / OPC UA is an advantage.
• MES and manufacturing systems is an advantage.

IT/OT
• Understanding of IT and OT environments.
• IT/OT system integration.
• Industrial networking fundamentals.
• Cybersecurity principles for industrial environments.
• Backup and recovery of industrial systems.

Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related field.
• Professional certifications in software development, industrial automation, networking, cybersecurity, or related technologies are an advantage.

Experience
• 3–5 years of relevant experience in software engineering, industrial software, application support, or a similar role.Exper

• ience with HMI, SCADA, PLC-related systems, databases, or industrial automation is an advantage.Exper
• ience in IT/OT integration and manufacturing systems is an advantage.

Behavioral & Professional Competencies
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent troubleshooting and diagnostic abilities.
• Ability to work under pressure, particularly during production-critical incidents.
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
• Ability to work effectively with IT, Production, Maintenance, and Engineering teams.
• Ability to communicate effectively with machine manufacturers and external vendors.
• Strong documentation and organizational skills.
• Attention to detail and commitment to system reliability.
• Ability to learn new technologies and industrial software platforms.

jobs.job_description:
We are seeking a software engineer with a passion for building and validating resilient distributed systems. At Canonical you can build a career and drive the success of those leveraging Canonical's Ubuntu and Juju to build multi-cloud deployable cloud applications.

We see quality engineering as a first class engineering practice and are looking for people who can bring deep engineering insights and a data driven approach to test automation, reporting and data analytics.

The Distributed Systems testing team at Canonical is responsible for ensuring the high quality of Canonical's Cloud solutions based on Juju, Terraform, OpenStack, Kubernetes when deployed under highly diverse conditions, from bare metal in customer data centers to public clouds like AWS, GCE, Azure.

As a software engineer you will have the opportunity to develop CI pipelines which power Canonical's cloud integration testing and reporting. Upcoming initiatives you will have the opportunity to contribute to include expanding deployment capabilities to new clouds and developing AI/ML pipelines for automatic analysis of test results. A successful candidate is interested in tackling these problems, as well as imagining and leading new initiatives within the team and across Canonical.

Location: this is a Globally remote role

What your day will look like

• Create automated testing approaches and infrastructure for validating reliability, performance, and resilience of cloud orchestration tools and applications
• Enable engineering teams across Canonical to develop software with confidence by making distributed system testing tooling available across the company
• Enhance continuous integration pipelines for deploying and testing Canonical's cloud native products such as Kubeflow
• Deploy, manage, and debug highly distributed systems
• Monitor and report on automated testing efforts
• Collaborate daily with a globally distributed team

What we are looking for in you

• Solid background in modern test processes and strategies
• Experience with Python or Go development
• Strong object oriented development skills
• Ability to develop and ship production grade modern web applications
• Working knowledge of continuous integration tools such as Jenkins, CircleCI, GitHub CI
• Knowledge of networking technologies and fundamentals
• Solid understanding of Linux system architecture
• A capacity for complex abstract thinking
• Capability for 2-4 weeks of international travel travel per year

Additional skills that you might also bring

• Collecting and analyzing large multidimensional datasets
• Operating data platforms: key-value stores, relational or document databases, event buses
• Work with cloud technologies such as OpenStack, Kubernetes, Terraform and AWS
• Developing AI/ML pipelines

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

• Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
• Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
• Annual compensation review
• Recognition rewards
• Annual holiday leave
• Maternity and paternity leave
• Employee Assistance Programme
• Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
• Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

Canonical believes a diverse workforce enhances our ability to deliver world class software and services which meet the world's computing needs. We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

The successful candidate will work closely with architects, business stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to deliver robust and innovative solutions.
